assertions.name: variance_matches_closed_form
assertions.note: (f^lam)^2 Sigma_p Sigma_q = (k)_p (k)_q chi(p) chi(q): the f^lam cancel, and column orthogonality gives Var = (k)_3^2/|C_3| = 3(k)_3

assertions.name: mixed_moments_vanish_for_all_distinct_p_q
assertions.note: EXACT uncorrelatedness, stronger than the CLT's asymptotic independence. Includes (3,5) and (2,4), which the omega-parity argument leaves free -- so orthogonality, not the twist, is what kills these

assertions.name: rho_is_negative_and_order_one
assertions.note: observed [-0.17738, -0.14487] over k=10..42. The conjecture is rho(k) <= 0, so route qou-t5m1 has a single dimensionless target near -0.164 to check a derivation against, not a sign

parameters.claim: Var_P(Sigma_3) = 3(k)_3 exactly; the conjecture is rho(k) <= 0 with rho ~ -0.164
